paper.title_en: Entropy and charge transport limit Mpemba preparation in holography
paper.abstract_en: We study Mpemba relaxation and its preparation cost in a holographic superconductor with full backreaction. At matched final energy and charge, boundary drives of finite duration can reverse the ordering of the remaining horizon entropy after source removal. In separate comparisons, some protocols reach a prescribed entropy tolerance earlier even when driving and waiting times are included. At criticality, a slow scalar field can persist even when little horizon entropy remains available for preparation and subsequent relaxation. Along the critical slow branch at fixed energy and charge, horizon displacement cancels the quadratic area response, leaving an entropy reserve of order $\varepsilon^4$ for an initial scalar amplitude $\varepsilon$. The same coefficient governs the entropy advantage of the nearby superconducting equilibrium and the entropy weight of the slow mode on the normal side. This weight vanishes in proportion to the mode's decay rate near the transition. Horizon area growth is quadratic in the covariant scalar flux. When the horizon remains smooth and its area growth uniformly controls the radial drift of the scalar field, the time needed to suppress the leading horizon field and exterior charge grows at least as $\varepsilon^{-2}$. Charge transfer fixes the signed area swept out by the time integral of this same flux, raising the minimum flux cost and strengthening the time bound.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在全息超导体模型中研究Mpemba弛豫及其制备成本，涉及视界熵、电荷输运与临界标度行为，属于全息凝聚态物理论题；理论构造具体（全背反、协变标量通量、ε^4熵储备与ε^-2时间下界），方法信号较强，摘要自洽清晰，虽然较新且引用为零，但按规则不因此扣分，值得点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 熵与电荷输运限制全息中的Mpemba制备
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在一个具有完全背反的全息超导体中研究Mpemba弛豫及其制备成本。在最终能量与电荷匹配的情况下，有限时长的边界驱动可以在撤去源之后逆转剩余视界熵的次序。在分别的比较中，即便把驱动与等待时间都计入，某些协议仍能更早达到规定的熵容差。在临界情形下，即便可用于制备及后续弛豫的视界熵所剩无几，慢标量场仍能持续存在。在固定能量与电荷的临界慢分支上，视界位移抵消了二次面积响应，对于初始标量振幅 ε，留下量级为 ε^4 的熵储备。同一系数同时支配附近超导平衡态的熵优势以及正常侧慢模的熵权重。该权重在相变附近与模的衰减率成比例地趋于零。视界面积增长与协变标量通量成二次关系。当视界保持光滑且其面积增长一致地控制标量场的径向漂移时，压制主导视界场与外部电荷所需的时间至少按 ε^{-2} 增长。电荷转移确定了同一通量的时间积分所扫过的带符号面积，从而提高了最小通量成本并强化了时间下界。
